correctness.rationale: Count of length-two nonfixed coordinatewise-involution orbits gives bound 2r(f+r). Quotient multigraph has balanced indegree/outdegree and is strongly connected. With at least one fixed symbol, an Euler tour starting there lifts to a closed word. Without fixed symbols, bit-xor voltage of a complete Euler tour is r² modulo two: if odd it obstructs a cyclic lift, and deleting one label-one loop gives a connected balanced graph with even voltage. Every claimed maximum is attained. The saved Python program independently checks its direct examples and small exhaustive upper bounds.

originality.rationale: The 26 March 2026 source proves only negation involutions with 1 or 2 fixed symbols and states general alphabet involutions as a research question; it notes only the binary order-two obstruction. This theorem determines all involutions at span two and produces a new infinite odd-r deficit family. Earlier pseudo de Bruijn and orientable constructions use reversal and therefore do not dominate the coordinatewise pairing.
